mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (review_no, parent_id, user_no, content) VALUES (#{reviewNo}, #{parentId}, #{userNo}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_no AS commentNo, c.review_no AS reviewNo, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.user_no AS userNo, c.content AS content, c.reg_date AS regDate, COALESCE(u.user_name, '탈퇴한 사용자') AS userName, COALESCE(u.user_img, 'default.png') AS userImg, CASE WHEN c.parent_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(pu.user_name, '탈퇴한 사용자') ELSE NULL END AS parentUserName FROM comment c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN comment pc ON c.parent_id = pc.comment_no LEFT JOIN users pu ON pc.user_no = pu.user_no WHERE c.review_no = #{reviewNo} ORDER BY COALESCE(pc.reg_date, c.reg_date) ASC, COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.comment_no) ASC, c.parent_id IS NOT NULL ASC, c.reg_date ASC, c.comment_no ASC
SELECT comment_no AS commentNo, review_no AS reviewNo, parent_id AS parentId, user_no AS userNo, content AS content, reg_date AS regDate FROM comment WHERE comment_no = #{commentNo}
